weights_source: Not found online (two review passes, 2026-10-28). INSTAT's NIPC (base 100 = 2016 average, 12 COICOP 1999 functions) shows a 'Pondération' column on its database page only for Ensemble 10 000,00 / Riz 1 785,44 / Non Riz 8 214,56 / Produits locaux 8 572,86; the function weights are presumably in the monthly NIPC Excel file, which the review tools could not read. Only partial statements were found: food and non-alcoholic beverages 'more than half' of the basket and rice 'nearly 18 %' (Newsmada, 3/12/2025, citing INSTAT). The 10-function weights printed in the 2017-2018 NIPC bulletins (e.g. INSTAT_NIPC_Jan2018: food, drinks and tobacco 5058 / 10 000) belong to the former base-2000 index and are not used. Deepening pass (28/10/2026, 12 searches): the database page and the March 2026 release page were re-read (no download besides INSTAT_NIPC-Mars-2026.xlsx, which the review fetcher returns as binary); TBE n°62 (April 2026) has only branch weights (Tableau 8) and NIPC changes (Tableaux 15-16); the IPC Antananarivo May 2022 PDF has contributions, not weights; the December 2018 NIPC PDF again shows base-2000 weights; searches of IMF country reports and AFRITAC South technical-assistance reports (2024 reports found concern Botswana, Seychelles, Marshall Islands), the central bank and ILO CPI descriptions found no base-2016 table. To be supplied by INSTAT (DSCVM) and mapped COICOP 1999 → 2018.
